meta.title: Ohana — Wedding & Event Planning
meta.description: Wedding and event planning and design in Madrid and destination, with close support from start to finish.

hero.title: Wedding & Event Planning
hero.subtitle: We design, plan and take care of every detail to create celebrations that speak of you.

about.title: About Ohana
about.body1: Ohana are the people we choose to share life's important moments with.
about.body2: We create and plan weddings and events with a close, careful and very personal approach. We like to listen, understand what you imagine and turn it into a celebration that makes sense for you.
about.body3: Behind the scenes there's planning, design, vendors, decisions and a great deal of organisation. In front, we want only what matters to remain: enjoying, celebrating and being with your people.
about.quote: How lucky, to have found each other.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.intro1: There are many ways to celebrate a wedding. Yours should look like nothing but you.
weddings.intro2: We're with you from the very first decisions to the last moment of the big day, taking care of the planning, the design, and everything that happens in between.
weddings.intro3: You live it. We make it happen.
weddings.servicesSubtitle: Every wedding starts differently. That's why there are different ways to support you, too.

integral.title: Full-service planning
integral.tagline: You have the story. We know how to shape it.
integral.description:
We shape your wedding and support you in every decision: we find the vendors that best fit you, take care of the budget, develop the design, and plan every detail so everything makes sense and follows one clear line.

And when the day arrives, all you have to do is live it. We make sure everything happens as planned.
integral.includes: planning · design · vendors · budget · timings · day-of coordination

diaB.title: Day-of coordination
diaB.tagline: You created the day. We make it all happen.
diaB.description: We step in during the final stretch to get to know every detail of your wedding, review everything you've organised, and coordinate all the vendors. On the big day, we'll be behind every timing, every setup and every moment, so you can be right where it matters: enjoying it with your people.
diaB.includes: final review · vendors · timing · setup · day-of coordination

finde.title: Ohana weekend
finde.tagline: Because bringing your people together deserves more than just one day.
finde.description: We design and coordinate the whole weekend experience: from the first pre-wedding gathering to the plan for the next day, creating different moments that connect with each other and let your celebration be lived from start to finish.
finde.includes: pre-wedding · wedding · after-party · design · vendors · coordination

intimas.title: Intimate weddings
intimas.tagline: Fewer guests. Closer to those who matter.
intimas.description: We design and plan intimate celebrations of up to 30 guests, where every choice can be cared for in a far more personal way. Special venues, a shared table, details thought out for each guest, and real time to enjoy your people.

destino.title: Destination weddings
destino.tagline: Wherever you want. Just as you've always imagined it.
destino.description: We plan your wedding in Spain, supporting you through the whole process, especially if you live abroad or choose to celebrate away from home. We find the right venues and vendors, coordinate logistics, and take care of every detail so distance never gets in the way.

medida.title: Bespoke planning
medida.tagline: Only where you need us. Exactly as much as you need.
medida.description: You may already have part of your wedding organised, or only need help at certain points. We build a service tailored to you, working only in the areas where you need support: vendor sourcing, design, budget, planning or advice.

events.title: Events
events.intro1: Some occasions call for something special.
events.intro2: We shape personal and brand events with a careful, personal touch, from the creative concept through to the coordination of the day.
events.intro3: You have the reason. We shape the celebration.

privados.title: Private events
privados.tagline: Good moments start with a good reason to come together.
privados.description:
Birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, special dinners and private celebrations designed around you and your people.

We shape every occasion, from the concept and venue search through to the food, decor, music and coordination, so all you have to do is enjoy it.
privados.includes: concept · venue · vendors · decor · food · coordination

corporativos.title: Corporate events
corporativos.tagline: Events that speak of your brand.
corporativos.description:
We design and organise brand experiences and company gatherings, taking care of both the concept and every detail of the execution.

Presentations, corporate dinners, team gatherings, celebrations and special events designed to connect with people and convey who you are.
corporativos.includes: concept · venue · production · vendors · experience · coordination

inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.subtitle: A small visual selection that speaks to our world: tables that bring people together, places that inspire, details that tell stories, moments that stay with you.

founder.body1: Ohana is much more than a project to me. It's an idea born from something very personal, and one I'm truly excited to watch grow.
founder.body2: I've spent years working in events, planning, coordinating and taking care of everything that happens behind the scenes so that, when the moment comes, everything works the way it should.
founder.body3: Creating Ohana is my way of devoting myself to everything that makes me happy: imagining, organising, caring for every detail and being part of days that mean so much.
founder.body4: And if there's one thing I want people to feel behind every celebration we create, it's exactly that: a lot of enthusiasm, a lot of care, and a huge amount of excitement to make it special.
founder.quote: How lucky, to have found each other.

contact.subtitle: Tell us about your wedding and we'll get back to you within 48 hours.
